title: Interview: Sales call routing and voice capacity
story: You meet Liam, the retail operations manager at Contoso.
He wants to change how Sales calls are handed out and how many calls each agent can handle.

interview.opening: We need to improve how sales calls are assigned and handled.

topics.ask: How are incoming sales calls given to agents today?
topics.answer: They go into the Sales queue but often one or two agents get most of the calls while others wait.

topics.ask: Do you want calls to be shared more evenly?
topics.answer: Yes. We want a steady rotation so everyone gets a fair share of calls.

topics.ask: How many calls should an agent handle at once?
topics.answer: Right now agents only take one. We want them to be able to manage more, maybe up to four at the same time.

topics.ask: Why do you want the higher limit?
topics.answer: So agents can handle callbacks and hold short tasks without losing efficiency.

extras.ask: Do you need a new phone number for sales?
extras.answer: Not right now. The current numbers work.

extras.ask: Do you want different hours for the Sales queue?
extras.answer: No. The current opening hours are fine.

extras.ask: Are there any special skills agents must have?
extras.answer: No special skills beyond normal sales training.
